ipo.rationale: Book is undersubscribed: max demand 200 lots vs 240 offered. Due diligence value ~4222. Pricing above that (4373+ for 150 lots or less) would break issue and leave bank with overpriced inventory. Price at 3945 gives ~7% discount to value for a modest pop, includes 170 lots of demand (all bids >=3945 filled fully), bank holds 70 on firm commitment. Balances issuer proceeds vs investor gain and break risk.

notes.name: OIL 300% Growth Note
notes.description: Pay $103 now. One year later receive at least $100 (so you could lose up to $3) plus 300% of any rise in OIL Corp shares from today. If OIL is flat or down you get $100. If OIL rises 2%, you get about $106. Example only, not a promise.
